extracted.name: Skinny Seven Layer Dip
extracted.description: Black beans replace refried beans in this spicy version of seven layer dip. Try mashing the beans before spreading into the dip if you prefer a smoother texture.
ingredient_lines: 1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained
1 (2.25 ounce) can sliced black olives, drained
instruction_lines: Mix together the sour cream, garlic, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, taco seasoning, hot pepper sauce, and 1/2 of the lemon juice in a bowl until well blended.
In another bowl, mash the avocado with the remaining lemon juice; set aside.
Spread the shredded lettuce over a 12-inch serving platter.
Layer the black beans evenly on top, followed by the Mexican-style corn.
Spread the prepared sour cream mixture over the corn.
Gently spread the avocado mixture on top of the sour cream.
Pour the salsa evenly over the avocado mixture.
Sprinkle the Mexican cheese blend, olives, green onions, and tomato on top.
